notes.title: (Ver. 2.02.01) Bug fixes and adjustments
notes.content:
👻Thanks for your time!🎃
Glad you continue to play with us.
Bug fixes and a few other updates for the Halloween update.

Sound is now played even when inactive.
Relaxed some end conditions.
Fixed some hints to make them easier to understand.
The following bugs have been fixed
 -When some endings are reached, jumpscares are not loaded and the game does not progress.
 --The cause cannot be determined, so the game will continue to progress even if the jumpscares are not loaded.
 -Multiple endings could be achieved in the Halloween room at the same time.
 -Only the sound of a window breaking is heard
 -Bats' shadows are hard to recognize
 -Anna's facial expression reverts back to during the event when in high ghost aura

We're preparing to produce a new horror game and a click game, so we hope you'll look forward to them!
([The Travel Game] also please visit us 🤗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123800/_/)

notes.title: Steam Scream Fest update (Ver.2.01.03)
notes.content:
Long time no see!
👻✨🎃Happy Halloween! 🎃✨👻
I'm happy to announce that [No Ghost is Stay Home] has been invited to the Steam Scream Fest (Halloween event)!

Thanks to all the people who bought the game and talked about it on the game's live stream, articles, etc.
Thank you so much.

[h3]Corresponding update[/h3].
👻Major updates to support the Halloween event.
...Ana's Room (Halloween) has been implemented.
　It can be purchased from the SHOP.
　(It is not DLC or a chargeable element, and coins can be obtained in-game.)
The events that occur in the Halloween room and 10 different endings have been added.
　*Only English/Japanese are supported.
The item "Ghost Aura Gauge" has been added. It makes it easier to see the ups and downs of the Ghost Aura.
　It can be turned on/off after purchase.

[h3]Other updates[/h3].
Tips added.
Some of the hint icons have been changed to be easier to understand.
(TV screen) Increased the appearance rate of Almy.
Removed the effect that the disability is reduced to 0 when Almy appears.
Fixed a bug that Ana's animation did not play when the exorcist appeared.
Minor bug fixes and adjustments.

That's all. If you notice anything, we would appreciate it if you could give us feedback via bulletin board, e-mail, Twitter DM, etc.
Have a great Halloween!

notes.title: (Ver.1.02.19) Several Update
notes.content:
Thanks for your help 👻. We've made a few updates.

It was possible to reach endings from the beginning that could only be reached by watching the other endings.(fixed)
Improved hint icons to make them easier to understand.

If you have any further questions, please feel free to leave feedback on the forums, Twitter DM, or email.
